UpdateSourceArgs:
-c "cd the-ship/2403; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.:bin GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.rtld.execstack=2 SteamAppId=2400
(script -qfec './srcds_i686 -game ship -console -usercon -port 27115 -ip 0.0.0.0 -maxplayers 16 +clientport 27105 -nohltv +rcon_password abc123 +map batavier' /tmp/ship_out.txt > /dev/null 2>&1; echo \"SRCDS EXIT $?\" >> /tmp/ship_out.txt) &
sleep 80
P=$(pgrep -f '^./srcds_i686' | head -1); echo \"PID $P\"
for i in 1 2 3; do grep -E 'State|Threads' /proc/$P/status | tr '\n' ' '; awk '{print \"utime\",$14,\"stime\",$15}' /proc/$P/stat; sleep 2; done
for t in /proc/$P/task/*; do echo \"$(basename $t) $(cat $t/comm) $(cat $t/wchan) $(awk '{print $3,$14}' $t/stat)\"; done
ls -l /proc/$P/fd 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $NF}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -15
cat /proc/net/udp | head -20; cat /proc/net/tcp | head -10
tr -d '\r' < /tmp/ship_out.txt | grep -v SOLID_VPHYSICS | tail -8
pkill -f srcds_i686; true
"
